arxiv-2202-07031.title: Transitions in Stochastic Non-equilibrium Systems: Efficient Reduction and Analysis
arxiv-2202-07031.creator: Mickaël D. Chekroun, Honghu Liu, James C. McWilliams, Shouhong Wang
arxiv-2202-07031.description: Abstract . A central challenge in physics is to describe non-equilibrium systems driven by randomness, such as a randomly growing interface, or fluids subject to random fluctuations that account e.g. for local stresses and heat fluxes in the fluid which are not related to the velocity and temperature gradients.

arxiv-2312-05901.title: AN EFFECTIVE FIELD THEORY STUDY OF MEDIUM HEAVY QUARK EVOLUTION
arxiv-2312-05901.creator: Miguel Ángel Escobedo
arxiv-2312-05901.description: Abstract The evolution of hard probes in a medium is a complex multiscale problem that significantly benefits from the use of Effective Field Theories (EFTs). Within the EFT framework, we aim to define a series of EFTs in a way that addresses each energy scale individually in separate steps. However, studying hard probes in a medium presents challenges.

arxiv-2401-11763.title: Three-Dimensional Velocity Diagnostics to Constrain the Type Ia Origin of Tycho’s Supernova Remnant Facilities: XMM-Newton (MOS) ( Turner et al. 2001 ) SAS 19.1.0 ( Gabriel et al. 2004 )
arxiv-2401-11763.creator: Hiroyuki Uchida, Tomoaki Kasuga, Keiichi Maeda, Shiu-Hang Lee, Takaaki Tanaka, Aya Bamba
arxiv-2401-11763.description: Abstract While various methods have been proposed to disentangle the progenitor system for Type Ia supernovae, their origin is still unclear. Circumstellar environment is a key to distinguishing between the double-degenerate (DD) and single-degenerate (SD) scenarios since a dense wind cavity is expected only in the case of the SD system.

arxiv-2508-08581.title: Baryon and Pseudoscalar Meson Octets within a Unified broken SU(6) symmetry
arxiv-2508-08581.creator: Luiz L. Lopes
arxiv-2508-08581.description: Abstract In this work, I discuss neutron stars with hyperons and anti-kaon condensate. To fix their coupling constants with the vector mesons of the Quantum Hadrodynamics, I use a unified scheme imposing that the Yukawa coupling is an invariant under SU(3) and SU(6) groups.

arxiv-2508-09537.title: Your Coding Intent is Secretly in the Context and You Should Deliberately Infer It Before Completion DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: Make sure to enter the correct conference title from your rights confirmation email; June 03–05, 2018; Woodstock, NY ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/2018/06
arxiv-2508-09537.creator: Yanzhou Li, Tianlin Li, Yiran Zhang, Shangqing Liu, Aishan Liu, Yang Liu
arxiv-2508-09537.description: Abstract . Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for function completion in repository-scale codebases. Prior studies demonstrate that when explicit instructions—such as docstrings—are provided, these models can generate highly accurate implementations. However, in real-world repositories, such annotations are frequently absent, and performance drops substantially without them. To address this gap, we frame the task as a three-stage process.

britannica-1911-pont-a-mousson.title: Pont-à-Mousson (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-pont-a-mousson.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-pont-a-mousson.description: Article 'Pont-à-Mousson' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 22), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. born at Vienne, department of Isére, on the 1st of June 1814. He was bred a lawyer, and his first performance in literature was a translation of Manfred (1837). His play Lucrèce was represented at the Théâtre Français on the 1st of April 1843. This date is a kind of epoch in literature and dramatic history, because it marked a reaction against the romantic style of Dumas and Hugo.

pmc-10695508.title: Renal abscess complicating acute pyelonephritis in children: Two cases report and literature review
pmc-10695508.creator: Zhuqin Zhan, Xiaoliang Lin, Guangbo Li, Jinhua Zeng, Dequan Su, Jianying Liao, Qian Shen
pmc-10695508.description: Rationale:To describe the diagnostic and treatment approaches of renal abscesses complicated with acute pyelonephritis in children.Patient concerns:Two children presented with fever, vomiting, and abdominal pain with no typical manifestations, like frequent urination, urgency, dysuria, hematuria, foam urine, and lumbago. Renal abscess complicating acute pyelonephritis was diagnosed by B-ultrasound and computed tomography enhancement.

pmc-11347202.title: Management of secondary mitral regurgitation: from drugs to devices
pmc-11347202.creator: Cara Barnes, Harish Sharma, James Gamble, Sam Dawkins
pmc-11347202.description: Severe secondary mitral regurgitation carries a poor prognosis with one in five patients dying within 12 months of diagnosis. Fortunately, there are now a number of safe and effective therapies available to improve outcomes. Here, we summarise the most up-to-date treatments.

pmc-11431853.title: A Comprehensive Review of Xanthan Gum-Based Oral Drug Delivery Systems
pmc-11431853.creator: Buddhadev Layek, Antonella Piozzi
pmc-11431853.description: Xanthan gum (XG) is an exopolysaccharide synthesized by the aerobic fermentation of simple sugars using Xanthomonas bacteria. It comprises a cellulosic backbone with a trisaccharide side chain connected to alternative glucose residues in the main backbone through α (1→3) linkage. XG dissolves readily in cold and hot water to produce a viscous solution that behaves like a pseudoplastic fluid.

pmc-11453800.title: 12452 Unraveling An Intriguing Clinical Sequence: Thyrotoxicosis Antecedent To Stiff Person Syndrome
pmc-11453800.creator: Ashali Jain, Melanie Natasha Rayan
pmc-11453800.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Title: Unraveling an Intriguing Clinical Sequence: Thyrotoxicosis Antecedent to Stiff Person Syndrome Background: Stiff Person Syndrome (SPS) is an autoimmune phenomenon resulting in the progressive rigidity of limbs and trunk muscles. It is associated with GAD-positive antibodies in the CSF and serum and is linked to Type 1 Diabetes, Celiac disease, and other autoimmune diseases. Clinical Case: A 34-year-old female with no past medical history was brought into the ED by family for paranoia, suicidal ideations, and visual and auditory hallucinations.

pmc-11610168.title: Early predictors of unfavorable outcomes in pediatric acute respiratory failure
pmc-11610168.creator: Shinya Miura, Nobuaki Michihata, Toshiaki Isogai, Hiroki Matsui, Kiyohide Fushimi, Hideo Yasunaga
pmc-11610168.description: ObjectiveAcute respiratory failure is a leading cause of critical illness in children. However, patient outcomes and early predictors of unfavorable outcomes are not well understood. This study aimed to describe composite unfavorable outcomes, defined as in-hospital death or discharge with new comorbidities, and to identify early predictors in children with acute respiratory failure in acute care hospitals.

pmc-11849696.title: Experiences of social prescribing in the UK: a qualitative systematic review
pmc-11849696.creator: Nur Hidayati Handayani, Marta Wanat, Stephanie Tierney
pmc-11849696.description: BackgroundSocial prescribing connects patients to resources or activities to meet their non-medical needs. In the UK, it is often implemented in primary care. In the social prescribing pathway, patients are directed to link workers to identify suitable solutions for their needs such as art workshops or welfare benefit guidance.

pmc-12405196.title: Psychotropic Medication-related Black Hairy Tongue: A Case Series
pmc-12405196.creator: Apurba Narayan Mahato, Jayashree Kalita, Trishita Chatterjee, Kamini Verma, Sucharita Mandal, Niru Das
pmc-12405196.description: iscomfort, altered taste sensation, and halitosis. 1 Even though blackish discoloration does not cause apparent harm, it can lead to discontinuation of prescribed medications, resulting in worsening of the primary condition. The most common drugs implicated in the development of BHT include psychotropics (such as olanzapine, chlorpromazine, and alprazolam), antibiotics (like linezolid), and antihypertensives (notably methyldopa).

pmc-13118783.title: Effect of Phthalocyanines Substitution Pattern on Their Loading into Bacterial Cellulose Nanocrystals
pmc-13118783.creator: Zeynel Şahin
pmc-13118783.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Photodynamic therapy (PDT) has already gained immense attention in the anti-tumor field due to its low toxicity and non-invasiveness compared to traditional treatment methods. Therefore, the development of efficient photosensitizers is crucial for the advancement of photodynamic therapy. Although phthalocyanines (Pcs) have attracted huge attention as efficient photosensitizers, their clinical applications are hindered by poor solubility and a tendency to aggregate. Herein, two different Pcs that have different polarities were loaded into bacterial cellulose nanoparticles via non-covalent interactions.

pmc-13165444.title: Fluorohydrocarbon Plasma Functionalization of Polyurethane Surfaces: Bacterial Adhesion and Cell Response
pmc-13165444.creator: Kamil Drożdż, Paulina Chytrosz-Wróbel, Divya Kumar, Karolina Zając, Andrzej Kotarba, Monika Brzychczy-Włocha
pmc-13165444.description: Polyurethanes (PUs) are widely used in biomedical applications; however, their surface properties critically determine bacterial colonization and cell response. In this study, medical-grade PU films were modified using low-pressure C3H2F4 plasma (50 W, 300 s, 0.2 mbar), and the resulting changes in surface chemistry, wettability, topography, bacterial adhesion, and cell compatibility were evaluated.
